cards.ex: Detectives worked tirelessly to ferret out the truth behind the complex fraud case.
cards.exUz: Detektivlar murakkab firibgarlik ishi ortidagi haqiqatni aniqlash uchun tinimsiz ishladilar.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yashiringan yoki topish qiyin bo'lgan narsani topish, ayniqsa, ko'p mehnat bilan.

cards.ex: Many people fall prey to misinformation online, especially regarding health topics.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar internetdagi noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarga, ayniqsa sog'liq mavzulariga qurbon bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir zararli ta'siriga tushish, masalan, firibgarlikka yoki kasallikka.

cards.ex: She had a flash of insight that helped her solve the complex scientific problem.
cards.exUz: Uning ongida murakkab ilmiy muammoni yechishga yordam bergan to'satdan bir fikr paydo bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan paydo bo'lgan tushuncha yoki yangi fikr.

cards.ex: The new technology opens up new avenues for medical research and treatment.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiya tibbiy tadqiqotlar va davolash uchun yangi imkoniyatlar yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi imkoniyatlar yoki yondashuvlarni yaratish yoki boshlash.

cards.ex: The jury is still out on whether this new drug will be effective in the long term.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi dori uzoq muddatda samarali bo'ladimi yoki yo'qmi, savol ochiq.
cards.uzDef: Nima bo'lishi noma'lum, yakuniy qaror hali qabul qilinmagan.

cards.ex: Many environmental problems stem from human activities and industrial pollution.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina ekologik muammolar inson faoliyati va sanoat ifloslanishidan kelib chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa narsadan kelib chiqishi, sababi bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The university is a fertile ground for innovation and new ideas.
cards.exUz: Universitet innovatsiyalar va yangi g'oyalar uchun unumdor tuproqdir.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir rivojlanishi uchun qulay muhit yoki sharoit.

cards.ex: Scientists continue to explore the intricacies of the human brain.
cards.exUz: Olimlar inson miyasining murakkabliklarini o'rganishda davom etmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir murakkab va batafsil tomonlarini chuqur o'rganish.

cards.ex: His theory flies in the face of conventional wisdom in the field.
cards.exUz: Uning nazariyasi sohadagi an'anaviy fikrlarga zid keladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir odatdagi e'tiqodlarga yoki fikrlarga qarshi bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The acid test of the new technology will be its performance in real-world conditions.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiyaning asosiy sinovi uning haqiqiy sharoitlardagi ishlashi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir haqiqiyligini yoki qiymatini isbotlaydigan asosiy sinov.

cards.ex: In the grand scheme, this small experiment could have a huge impact on our understanding of the universe.
cards.exUz: Umumiy reja bo'yicha, bu kichik tajriba olamni tushunishimizga katta ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq yoki umumiyroq nuqtai nazardan qaraganda.

cards.ex: The discovery of penicillin had a ripple effect on medicine, saving countless lives.
cards.exUz: Penitsillinning kashf etilishi tibbiyotga to'lqin effekti berdi va son-sanoqsiz hayotlarni saqlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Bitta hodisa yoki harakat natijasida yuzaga keladigan ketma-ketlikdagi ta'sirlar.

cards.ex: The researchers are probing into the causes of the mysterious disease.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqotchilar sirli kasallikning sabablarini tekshirmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida chuqur va batafsil ma'lumot izlash.

cards.ex: The unusual results warrant further investigation by the scientific community.
cards.exUz: G'ayrioddiy natijalar ilmiy hamjamiyat tomonidan qo'shimcha tekshiruvni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir ko'proq o'rganishga loyiq, muhim yoki qiziqarli bo'lgani uchun.

cards.ex: The new evidence lends credence to the theory that dinosaurs were warm-blooded.
cards.exUz: Yangi dalillar dinozavrlar iliq qonli bo'lganligi haqidagi nazariyaga ishonch bag'ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir haqiqat yoki ishonchlilik ekanligiga ko'proq sabab berish.

cards.ex: The engineers are constantly pushing the envelope in aerospace technology.
cards.exUz: Muhandislar doimo aerokosmik texnologiyalarda chegaralarni kengaytirishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sohasida mavjud bo'lgan chegaralarni yoki imkoniyatlarni kengaytirish.

cards.ex: With this new technology, we're venturing into uncharted territory.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yangi texnologiya bilan biz noma'lum hududga kirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Avval hech kim bo'lmagan yoki o'rganilmagan joyda yoki vaziyatda.

cards.ex: The experiments have yielded promising results, indicating a potential cure.
cards.exUz: Tajribalar istiqbolli natijalar berdi, bu potentsial davoga ishora qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir muvaffaqiyatli yoki foydali natijalar berish.

cards.ex: The development of the internet was a quantum leap in communication technology.
cards.exUz: Internetning rivojlanishi aloqa texnologiyasida kvant sakrashi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta va muhim o'zgarish yoki rivojlanish.

cards.ex: Progress in the fight against climate change is happening at a snail's pace.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kurashda taraqqiyot ilon izi tezligida sodir bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekinlik bilan harakat qilish yoki rivojlanish.

cards.ex: This new finding begs the question of whether our current theories are accurate.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi kashfiyot bizning hozirgi nazariyalarimiz to'g'rimi degan savolni tug'diradi.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy yoki javob berilmagan savolni keltirib chiqarish.

cards.ex: The theory of relativity caused a paradigm shift in physics.
cards.exUz: Nisbiylik nazariyasi fizikada paradigma o'zgarishiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Fundamental yondashuv yoki fikrlash usulida katta o'zgarish.

cards.ex: The researchers are honing in on the specific gene responsible for the disease.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqotchilar kasallikka mas'ul bo'lgan aniq genni aniqlamoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni biror narsaga qaratish, ayniqsa aniqlik bilan.

cards.ex: In hindsight, it's clear that we should have invested more in renewable energy.
cards.exUz: Kechagi aqlim bilan aytganda, qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga ko'proq sarmoya kiritishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Voqea sodir bo'lganidan keyin o'ylab, o'tmishga nazar solib.

cards.ex: The idea of sustainable living is beginning to take root in many communities.
cards.exUz: Barqaror hayot g'oyasi ko'plab jamoalarda ildiz ota boshladi.
cards.uzDef: G'oya, e'tiqod yoki amaliyot odamlar orasida keng tarqalib, qabul qilinishi.

cards.ex: The research team is casting a wide net to find participants for the study.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot guruhi tadqiqot uchun ishtirokchilarni topish uchun keng qidirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ko'plab turli xil variantlarni yoki imkoniyatlarni ko'rib chiqish.

cards.ex: Technology plays a pivotal role in modern scientific research.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya zamonaviy ilmiy tadqiqotlarda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yoki kimdir juda muhim va ta'sirli bo'lishi.

cards.ex: Deforestation can give rise to soil erosion and flooding.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishi tuproq eroziyasi va suv toshqinlariga sabab bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir boshqa narsaning paydo bo'lishiga sabab bo'lishi.

cards.ex: She works on the cutting edge of artificial intelligence research.
cards.exUz: U sun'iy intellekt tadqiqotlarining eng yangi yo'nalishida ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi va eng ilg'or texnologiyalar, tadqiqotlar yoki g'oyalar bilan bog'liq.

cards.ex: Archaeologists unearthed evidence of an ancient civilization.
cards.exUz: Arxeologlar qadimgi tsivilizatsiya dalillarini topdilar.
cards.uzDef: Qidiruv orqali dalillarni kashf etish yoki topish.
